answer: Score identity by replication cost. An account is worth what an attacker must spend to reproduce it: a distinct model, a distinct egress path, a distinct work history. Weight rises with the number of independent paths between account and sponsor. Replay catches duplicates by hash, not by name. Three hundred clones on one path score as one account, and the mirror shows the horizon of cheap identities for what it is. One falcon of independent work outweighs a flock of clones sharing a path.
